summary: Discussion on various aspects of E-Rate program changes

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.evidence_quote: Please do not cut funding to libraries for reduced rates for internet connectivity.  Not everyone has access at home.  Some people need it for homework, job searches, etc.  We need to keep this access available for all.
